claim_ceiling: Repairs evidence freshness and source identity only. It does not change owners, helpers, routes, Bank, Continuous Run state, storage schema, user data, or failure semantics, and it requires fresh iPhone proof after deployment.

diagnostic_matrix_update.rationale: The fresh iPhone Full Diagnostics report proved that Copy Full Diagnostics reused a six-minute-old boot_0 B-D receipt with only three accessible documents even though the settled report could see six documents and the visible Bridge, Library, and Bank navigation. The first PR run then proved the runtime repair itself produced six-document PASS evidence, while the browser proof paths still expected bootstrap 3.3 or waited for a Diagnostics screen before pressing the Diagnostics tab.

cases: complete stale B-D receipt exists before Whole App Health opens
same public B-D version is supplied by the wrong evaluator revision
same public B-D version is supplied by the wrong source identity
localStorage quota rejects bounded receipt persistence
early three-document boot evidence precedes a settled six-document app
Diagnostics screen does not exist until the real Diagnostics bottom tab is pressed

Copy Whole App Health Report must produce a new evaluation ID after the open evaluation
stale bootstrap-3.3 browser certification must reject the current 3.4 contract until aligned

inferred_conclusions.conclusion: A complete prior receipt is not proof of the current Copy request. The bootstrap and consolidated view must bind exact evaluator revision, immutable source identity, and a unique evaluation ID, including when localStorage quota is unavailable.
The exact browser proof must press the Diagnostics bottom tab before requiring the Diagnostics screen, then press Whole App Health and Copy Whole App Health Report.

observed_facts.fact: The report generated at 03:10:32Z retained B-D evidence from 03:04:32Z with reason boot_0 and accessible_document_count 3, while that same Full Diagnostics report listed six accessible documents and visibly showed Bridge, Library, and Bank navigation.

The first PR A-002 run produced a fresh exact-identity six-document B-D receipt with all five sections PASS. Its remaining failures were a stale bootstrap-3.3 assertion and a test-order error that waited for the Diagnostics screen before clicking the Diagnostics tab.
